digest.component_or_area: build and CI automation, Makefile and linting gates
propositions: The scripts/ directory is currently excluded from static linting gates (make lint and make typecheck), but contains 41 files with 78 ruff check violations and 7 formatting violations, including 28 substantive issues across RUF100, E501, RUF005, RUF059, and B905 rules

Adding scripts/ to Makefile sources requires fixing both ruff check violations and formatter conformance in a single coordinated change, and consolidating 9 per-file T201 exemptions into one directory-wide entry while removing 28 now-redundant inline noqa directives to prevent new RUF100 violations

Seven gate scripts invoked directly by _build-and-test.yml (.github/workflows) are themselves ungated despite being blocking workflow requirements, creating a risk that defects in the gate implementations themselves are undetected

The 28 substantive violations are zero-behavior fixes: 12 dead RUF100 directives removed by ruff --fix, 11 line wraps, 2 collection-concat rewrites, 2 unused-unpack variable prefixes, and 1 zip(strict=True) hardening on equal-length lists
